name: brand-kit
description: Logos designed as clean SVG with typefaces chosen from real Google Fonts on a specimen sheet, exported from one brand.json to SVG and PNG logos, dark and one-colour versions, favicons, app and PWA icons, a webmanifest, printable brand guidelines (US Letter PDF), vector PDF logos, social images, an email signature, business card, slide template and social post templates, and one zip of the kit. Also makes icon sets for existing logos.
